annotations.text:
APP STORE — iPhone 6.7" · 1290 × 2796
Export each artboard as PNG at natural size and upload in this order.

Apple shows the first 3 in search results, so slots 1–3 carry the pitch:
who we are → 0% commission → safety.

Fares, addresses, names and counts are SAMPLE data — swap for real
values (or clearly fictional ones) before you submit.

Spinr Driver is a separate store listing, so it gets its own set.
Same 1290 × 2796 spec, same visual system, driver-side story:
keep 100% → see the fare before accepting → paid weekly + T4A.

"No penalty for passing, no shift you have to sign up for" is deliberate
contractor-safe wording — keep control-of-work language out of app copy.

GOOGLE PLAY — 1080 × 1920 (9:16)
Play rejects anything taller than 9:16, so the 2796-tall App Store
images can NOT be reused here. Same phone markup, scaled to 0.75.

These two are the pattern; the remaining six reflow the same way
once you've settled the copy.

Three alternates to the built direction (dark premium), low-fi on purpose.

B · Bright & civic — warm light ground, dark type. Friendlier and more
   local-feeling; the phone pops less against a light background.
C · Split block — hard red/charcoal seam. Loudest in a crowded search
   result; harder to keep varied across eight frames without shouting.
D · Full bleed — no marketing chrome at all. Most honest; leans entirely
   on the UI being beautiful on its own.

Say which one and I'll rebuild the whole set in it.
